name: Salve
description: A Wishing Well E.L.F. designed to optimize pain management in black-market augments running without proper calibration.
observed_behavior: Adjusts nerve-interface sensitivity thresholds to reduce chronic pain from poorly installed cyberware. Cannot heal — can make the hurt more bearable.
location: Tier 1 zones with high augmentation rates
story_hooks: A chronic pain sufferer loses their Salve during a firmware update and realizes how much the E.L.F. was doing
